title: Epistemic Curiosity & Socratic Scaffolding Engine
narrative: Current educational and knowledge-retrieval systems enforce linear progression. When a learner hits a cognitive wall—particularly in highly abstract domains like category theory or pure mathematics—standard systems provide definitive answers rather than structural scaffolding. This bypasses the necessary struggle, destroying meta-curiosity and creating fragile, disconnected knowledge graphs.

actors.name: The Explorer
motivations: Navigate abstract knowledge spaces (Category Theory, Pure Mathematics)
Define and expand current conceptual boundaries through authentic discovery
Test bold conjectures safely with reversible rollback from dead-ends
frustrations: Linear progression walls that ignore non-linear mathematical intuition
Systems that prematurely dump textbook answers instead of structural scaffolding
Fragile, disconnected mental models caused by bypassing productive struggle

actors.name: The Socratic Probe
actors.role: Dialectical Frontier Agent (Local RTX 4060 Ollama Qwen 2.5)
motivations: Operate strictly on the frontier of the Explorer's verified knowledge boundary
Generate dialectical friction via structural questions and Lakatosian counter-axioms
Maintain zero-latency (<25ms) local hardware execution without cloud reliance
frustrations: Enterprise cloud latency breaking Socratic flow
Sycophantic answer-giving that short-circuits epistemic struggle

actors.name: The Epistemic Validator
actors.role: Formal Compositional Contract & Statechart Verification Engine
motivations: Formally verify conceptual integration before unlocking higher-order abstractions
Enforce strict compositional pre-conditions ('Mastery of Morphisms' before 'Exploring Functors')
Preserve functorial undo history across conceptual dead-end rollbacks
frustrations: Unverified self-reported progress allowing premature entry into higher abstractions
State corruption when learners hit contradictions without deep-history rollback
